ideas.idea: Make delivery/shipping promise machine-readable with a visible shipping page, keeping the data-nosnippet block
ideas.why: The only delivery terms sit in a nosnippet block and a visible page would back the 'next day' claim without reversing the deliberate choice.

ideas.idea: Give each product its own page with name, price and description
ideas.why: /shop is a single page listing categories in one sentence, so individual product URLs would give crawlers real items and let Product data describe them.

ideas.idea: Link from the home page to categories/products with a short intro
ideas.why: The home page is only an h1 and relies on the nav, so a short intro with links adds content and crawl paths.

ideas.idea: Add a viewport meta tag in app.html
ideas.why: src/app.html really lacks a viewport meta, which affects mobile rendering and mobile-first indexing.

ideas.idea: Wrap page content in a <main> landmark
ideas.why: Accurate (children render outside any landmark) but it has little effect on discoverability and applies to almost any site.

ideas.idea: Product JSON-LD is injected client-side via {@html} and will work once SSR is on
ideas.why: It is a consequence of the known ssr=false problem and is fixed by that same change.
